{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined dark grey silk-blend blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed collar, mid-thigh length, #2C2F33, matte woven fabric.
Tailored charcoal wool trousers with a slight taper at the ankle, full length, #1E2025, heavy worsted wool.
A structured black cashmere-blend blazer with notched lapels and single-button closure, hip length, #0D0F10, fine-gauge knit.
Black suede pointed-toe pumps with a 7 cm stiletto heel, ankle height, #000000, soft leather upper.
Delicate gold-plated drop earrings, stud detail, #FFD700, polished metal.
A slim black satin clutch with a silver chain strap, hand-held size, #111111, smooth synthetic satin.

This ensemble strikes the perfect balance for an evening birthday celebration in autumn, offering warmth and elegance under artificial light while adhering to the smart dress code requested. The dark, neutral color palette flatters her complexion and creates a sophisticated silhouette that feels both polished and comfortable for a night out with friends. The mix of textures—from the fluid silk blouse to the structured cashmere blazer and soft suede shoes—adds visual interest without overwhelming the eye, ensuring she stands out gracefully at the party."}
